Markets - Sales and Trading - Off-Cycle Internship

Location: 

London, GB, E14 5HQ

Programme Type: Internship Programme
Closing Date: Thu Oct 15, 2026

Area of Interest: Trading; Sales and Investments

Business Area: Corporate and Institutional Banking

About the business area

Our corporate and institutional bank serves large companies, governments and investors around the world, helping them raise money, manage risk and move capital between markets.

Who you are

You are analytical and curious, you enjoy fast-moving markets, and you communicate clearly with colleagues and clients under time pressure.

What you'll do

You will rotate across sales and trading desks, support pricing and client coverage, analyse market moves and help with the daily risk process alongside experienced traders.

What you'll learn

A week of classroom training on markets and products is followed by on-desk learning, mentoring and regular feedback from the teams you join.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Be available to work full time from March 2027 onwards
  • Have obtained, or expect to achieve, a 2:1 degree or an overseas equivalent
  • Be fluent in English

We only accept one application per recruitment cycle, so please explore our opportunities before applying.
